cross_product_hole_evidence.finding: seven products lose exactly the same two sessions while their own maximum date is 2026-09-24. That signature repeats the sibling-release mechanism recorded in R05 and is not limited to stock daily. VALUATION_PIT_R1 additionally misses 2026-08-03..2026-08-10 and FUND_NAV_PIT_R1 misses six further scattered sessions; those extra holes are recorded and left unadjudicated
cross_product_hole_evidence.not_a_conclusion: this comparison is a date-set fact only. It does not prove the same driver caused every product, and it does not authorise a repair of the other products
